english.meaning: to fall asleep briefly; to nap when drowsy
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Ugh, I’m sleepy, but I can’t sleep on my stomach. It’s really tough. I used to just sleep whenever I felt sleepy.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哎眼瞓又唔可以趴喺度瞓呢，超辛苦啊真係。以前瞌眼瞓都照瞓𡃉喇。
